added.summary: Every look has six shape images coloured by the element's fill (`bg-*`): `nine-disc` and `nine-ring` for radial cooldown and progress wipes, `nine-tile` for a square slot, and `nine-plate-cut`, `nine-panel-cut` and `nine-chip-cut` for cut-corner HUD plates, panels and badges. A game with a TSX UI or a document carries them.

The default pack declares the slots a pack dresses: `Button.plate` (and `.primary`), `Panel.frame`, `Plate.frame`, `Slot.frame`, `Chip.frame` and `Field.frame`, so `packClass("Panel", "frame")` resolves under every pack. A variant may be an empty string, which declares a slot and adds nothing. The fantasy pack dresses buttons in its iron and red plates and panels in its filigree frame; scifi dresses all six in its cut shapes.
